speaker: no_speaker
message: Some time later at Hololive Headquarters

speaker: Kronii
message: Hi Yagoo, may I come in?

speaker: Yagoo
message: Hi Kronii, how maybe I help you?

speaker: Kronii
message:
Oh um, it's uh. Ahem. Yagoo, I've given it some thought.
	And, I think it's about time I graduate.

speaker: Yagoo
message: Ah. I knew this time would come eventually.

speaker: Yagoo
message:
Of course. It's been over 100,000 years since you
	became the last active member of Hololive Productions.

speaker: Kronii
message:
It's really been that long huh?
    It feels like only yesterday when I debuted with the rest of Council.
    ... But is it really okay if I leave? What will you do Yagoo?
	What about the future of Hololive?

speaker: Yagoo
message:
Ah... Of course I'll be sad to see you go.
    No matter the era, it's always sad to see a talent go.
    But even for a warden of time, all things must come to an end eventually.
    You still have your whole life ahead of you-
    many new, wonderful things to explore and experience.
    Even if Hololive comes to an end, it'll truly never die.
    The laughs, the tears, the memories...
	All of it will live on in our hearts and souls.

speaker: Yagoo
message:
Go forth, Warden of time.
	It's time for you to give the fans one last show to remember.

speaker: Kronii
message:
Thank you, Yagoo. Thank you for everything.
	I'll make you proud!

speaker: Kronii
message: Alright! Let's make this last month count!
